priorReason: Sign handling has obvious boundaries at zero and at the smallest magnitude. A fix that only tests '-1KB' would leave several unconstrained.
prompt: Bug report: bytes.format(-1024) returns '-1KB' but bytes.parse('-1KB') returns null, so a formatted value cannot be round-tripped. Please make parse accept a leading minus sign and update the tests.
